resolved.title: 类方法 - Class Method
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Class Methods[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Methods of objects we've looked at so far are called by an instance of a class, which is then passed to the [b]self[/b] parameter of the method.
[b]Class methods[/b] are different -- they are called by a class, which is passed to the [b]cls[/b] parameter of the method. 
A common use of these are factory methods, which instantiate an instance of a class, using different parameters than those usually passed to the class constructor. 
Class methods are marked with a [b]classmethod decorator[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="418"]class Rectangle:
  def __init__(self, width, height):
    self.width = width
    self.height = height

  def calculate_area(self):
    return self.width * self.height

  [b]@classmethod
  def new_square(cls, side_length):
    return cls(side_length, side_length)[/b]

square = [b]Rectangle.new_square(5)[/b]
print(square.calculate_area())[/code]
[b]new_square [/b]is a class method and is called on the class, rather than on an instance of the class. It returns a new object of the class [b]cls[/b].
[note]Technically, the parameters [b]self [/b]and [b]cls [/b]are just conventions; they could be changed to anything else. However, they are universally followed, so it is wise to stick to using them.[/note]

而**类方法**则不同--它们是由一个类来调用的，这个类传递给方法的第一个**cls**参数。

这些方法的一个常见用途是工厂方法(返回一个类对象)，和类构造函数来实例化一个类的对象有点区别。

resolved.title: 静态方法 Static Method
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Static Methods[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Static methods[/b] are similar to class methods, except they don't receive any additional arguments; they are identical to normal functions that belong to a class. 
They are marked with the [b]staticmethod [/b]decorator.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="419"]class Pizza:
  def __init__(self, toppings):
    self.toppings = toppings

 [b] @staticmethod[/b]
  def validate_topping(topping):
    if topping == "pineapple":
      raise ValueError("No pineapples!")
    else:
      return True

ingredients = ["cheese", "onions", "spam"]
if all(Pizza.[b]validate_topping[/b](i) for i in ingredients):
  pizza = Pizza(ingredients) [/code]
[note]Static methods behave like plain functions, except for the fact that you can call them from an instance of the class. [/note]
[s0l0!-coach id="1084" name="Define The Methods" xp="10" description="In order to make the code work, define the Shape class, and the static area() method which should return the multiplication of its two arguments." imageUrl="/content/assets/fbf4383f92a3bd1d06f6.png" button="Start" color="366D9B"]Practice what you've learned.[/s0l0!-coach]

content.text:
**静态方法**是类中的函数，不需要实例。静态方法主要是用来存放逻辑性的代码，但是和类本身没有交互【不需要创建类的实例对象而是直接使用类名.静态方法调用】，即在静态方法中，不会涉及到类中的方法和属性的操作。

另外，静态方法可以不带任何参数，由于静态方法没有`self`参数，所以它无法访问类的实例成员；静态方法也没有`cls`参数，所以它也无法访问类成员。静态方法既可以通过对象名调用，也可以通过类名调用。

静态方法通过`staticmethod`来标记。

**例子：**
content.text_html:
Static methods are similar to class methods, except they don't receive any additional arguments; they are identical to normal functions that belong to a class. They are marked with the **staticmethod **decorator.

Example:

为了使代码工作，你需要定义**Shape**类，以及静态`area()`方法，它返回两个参数的乘积。

[s0l0!-header][h1]Static Methods[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The given code takes 2 numbers as input and calls the static [b]area[/b]() method of the [b]Shape[/b] class, to output the area of the shape, which is equal to the height multiplied by the width.
To make the code work, you need to define the Shape class, and the static area() method, which should return the multiplication of its two arguments.
